  • Support CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD.
  • Troubleshoot issues across infrastructure, networking, containers, and applications.

  • Work on networking components such as load balancers, API gateways, reverse proxies, and service communication.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post‑mortems.
  • Automate repetitive tasks with scripts and tools to improve efficiency.
  • Maintain documentation for infrastructure, deployments, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to improve system reliability and deployment workflows.
  • Participate in on‑call or shift rotations to ensure system availability.

Cloud Platforms and Services

  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of AWS (ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, SNS).
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of GCP (GKE, GAR, CloudSQL, Cloud Run).
  • Understanding of cloud‑native architectures and distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure provisioning (Terraform/CloudFormation is a plus).

Monitoring and Logging Tools

  • Experience with CloudWatch Logs, Loki, Splunk.
  • Familiarity with Prometheus and Grafana for metrics and dashboards.
  • Knowledge of Alertmanager and incident response workflows.

Networking and Security

  • Strong understanding of load balancers (ALB, NLB).
  • Experience with API Gateways (AWS API Gateway, NGINX).
  • Knowledge of reverse proxies and ingress controllers (NGINX Ingress, Traefik).
  • Understanding of service‑to‑service communication (DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, gRPC).
  • Hands‑on with firewalls, security groups, IAM roles.
  • Troubleshooting VM issues on platforms like AWS EC2.

DevOps Toolchains

  • Proficiency with Docker.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes concepts and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD.
  • Knowledge of ingress controllers and SSL termination.

Troubleshooting & Incident Management

  • Strong problem‑solving skills using logs, metrics, and system‑level debugging.
  • Ability to document detailed troubleshooting steps.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Ability to work with cross‑functional teams (DevOps, Development, Operations).
  • Effective communication for incident escalation and shift handovers.
  • Proficiency with Slack, JIRA, Confluence, Google Workspace.
summary: Junior DevOps Engineer role focusing on cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines. Requires 0.5‑2 years experience with AWS and Kubernetes.
